    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Victoria ~ 'victoire' (fr) + 'ria' (es, laughter); also 'vick' (en, to move quickly) + 'toria' (hebrew, torah = law/teaching)",
    "reading": "Laughter after swift conquest; the joy of the law fulfilled.",
    "languages": ["fr", "es", "he", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },

    "operation": "anagram",

    "reading": "City of the sun's heart; life centered in a radiant civic core.",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.45
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",

    "reading": "Universal and eternal power manifest across all realms of being.",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "V (valley, vulva) + I (eye, self) + C (crescent, moon) + T (cross, tree) + O (circle, sun) + R (road, return) + I (again) + A (alpha, beginning)",
    "reading": "From the valley of self, through moon and cross, to the sun's return — a cyclic rebirth.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.55
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "V=5, I=1, C=100, T=200 (Greek tau), O=70 (omicron), R=80 (rho), I=1, A=1 → sum 458; 4+5+8=17; 1+7=8 (infinity, renewal)",
    "reading": "The number eight — eternal spiral; victory as endless return of the same.",
    "languages": ["la", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Victoria from Latin victoria, but also from vicus (village, settlement) + -toria (place of); cf. victor = conqueror, but vicus = dwelling",
    "reading": "A place of dwelling that conquers; settlement as triumph over wilderness.",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "de Vaan, Etymological Dictionary of Latin, s.v. victoria, vicus",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Vic + toria; 'vic' (Old English wic = camp, dwelling) + 'toria' (Greek toria = watchtower, from teirein to guard)",
    "reading": "A guarded camp; victory as vigilance over a fortified home.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.55
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Victoria ~ 'vikt' (Swedish, to dedicate) + 'oria' (Latin, from os, oris = mouth); also 'victor' (en) + 'ia' (suffix of land)",
    "reading": "Dedicated mouth of the land; victory spoken as a vow of territory.",
    "languages": ["sv", "la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.45
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Victoria → 'Civita' (Italian, city) + 'ro' (French, wheel); also 'Vita' (life) + 'cori' (heart) + 'a' (to)",
    "reading": "City-wheel of life; victory as the turning heart of a living polis.",
    "languages": ["it", "fr", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "V (vine) + I (pillar) + C (cup) + T (tau, cross) + O (omega) + R (resh, head) + I (yod, hand) + A (aleph, ox)",
    "reading": "Vine-pillar, cup-cross, omega-head, hand-ox — the alchemical marriage of plant and spirit.",
    "languages": ["he", "grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  }
]
